episodes.final_message: Midterm week with deadlines and classes can be really draining, especially with stress running high today. If you're studying tonight, consider pausing for a 5-minute reset—maybe make a cup of warm tea and do a few gentle shoulder stretches away from your screen. It's a quick, simple way to give your mind a moment to unbend.
